# PrymaLab

> > PrymaLab is a US-based research peptide laboratory offering 99%+ pure, HPLC-verified peptides for longevity, performance, and therapeutic research.

PrymaLab is a veteran-owned American peptide research laboratory based in Ashland, Kentucky, specializing in high-purity research peptides including growth hormone secretagogues, anti-aging compounds, healing peptides, and metabolic modulators. The company provides same-day shipping, secure checkout, and comprehensive customer support with educational tools like peptide calculators.
